notes: Telegram reliability hardening plus two console safety fixes. The bot no longer goes silent on a transient error: typing heartbeats now survive up to five consecutive failures before stopping (with one honest TYPING_FAIL log line), a streaming edit and the final send each retry once before giving up, and the long-poll loop logs POLL_RECOVER n=<errors> when transport comes back - the disconnect class that swallowed whole turns on 11-11 now heals itself and leaves a trail. An IN line at the update-handler gate records chat id and message kind only, never content. Console: leaving Settings with pending edits now raises an unsaved-changes prompt (reusing the existing takeover layer, zero new locale keys, urgent alerts still win) instead of silently dropping them, with SAVE/CANCEL/Esc flows and a native beforeunload prompt on tab close; the chat card's model dropdown refreshes after every save without a page reload; and the endpoint list no longer repaints while an edit is in progress, so a background read can never detach the input you are typing into (this also removed a rare E2E race). Quality: core 2494/2494, console smoke 558/558, setup wizard 123/123, skill router 37/37, memory 58/58, profile isolation 63/63, ckx round-trip 38/38, desktop shell 23/23, locale packs 1555 per pack, srclint 0, publish gate READY(0), doctor 0 FAIL 0 WARN, E2E batch 36 pass with 2 known helper skips (invoked with argv by their parent suite).
